title.narrative: Multi Donor Trust Fund for Clean Energy Investment Framework

description.narrative: "The development objectives of this Trust Fund is to enable the World Bank to provide advisory, analytical and knowledge management services to support the implementation of the Clean Energy Investment Framework (CEIF). More specifically, provision of funding willenable the World Bank, through ESMAP, to: a) support the development of energy scale up country action plans, syndication country programs in Sub-Saharan Africa, and the Africa Energy Access Action Plan as described in Pillar 1 of the CEIF, including analytical work, capacity building, and upstream feasibility analysis. b) undertake the analytical work to support the efforts of developing countries (especially the G+5 Brazil, China, India,Mexico andSouth Africa) to move towards a low carbon economy; including the development of new analytical frameworks, evaluation of financing mechanisms, and related climate change mitigation work, as described in Pillar 2 of the CEIF c) undertake analytical work, support capacity building efforts, develop screening tools, and build the capacity of institutions onadaptation to climate change, as described in Pillar 3 of the CEIF."
